facts.heading: Burnout started in October
facts.content: Daniel has been completely burned out since October.
facts.evidence: I've been completely burned out since October.

facts.heading: Work situation led to burnout
facts.content: Daniel lost a big client, and half of his team was moved onto a rescue plan.
facts.evidence: We lost a big client, and half the team got moved onto the rescue plan

facts.heading: Daniel doing multiple jobs
facts.content: Daniel ended up doing three people's jobs.
facts.evidence: so I ended up doing three people's jobs.

facts.heading: Work hours are very long
facts.content: Daniel starts work at seven and still answers messages at ten at night.
facts.evidence: I'm at my desk by seven and I'm still answering messages at ten at night.

facts.heading: Sleep is terrible
facts.content: Daniel sleeps about four hours most nights.
facts.evidence: Most nights I sleep about four hours.

facts.heading: Wakes up at three AM
facts.content: Daniel wakes up at three in the morning and cannot fall back asleep.
facts.evidence: I wake up at three in the morning and can't fall back asleep.

facts.heading: Worrying about work at night
facts.content: When Daniel wakes up at three, he thinks about shipping schedules and the client.
facts.evidence: Shipping schedules, the client, whether I've forgotten something.

facts.heading: Dreading nights due to sleep
facts.content: Daniel has started dreading the nights.
facts.evidence: I've started dreading the nights, if I'm honest.

facts.heading: Father diagnosed with Parkinson's
facts.content: Daniel's father was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease in the autumn.
facts.evidence: My father. He was diagnosed with Parkinson's disease in the autumn.

facts.heading: Father's physical symptoms
facts.content: Daniel's father's hands shake, and he is slower.
facts.evidence: His hands shake, and he's slower,

facts.heading: Daniel drives father to hospital
facts.content: Daniel drives his father to the hospital in Leeds for neurology appointments.
facts.evidence: I'm the one who drives him to the hospital in Leeds.

facts.heading: Caregiving falls on Daniel
facts.content: Daniel is the one responsible for the care of his father.
facts.evidence: all the care for our father falls on me.

facts.heading: Guilt about being tired
facts.content: Daniel feels guilty for being tired when his father is ill.
facts.evidence: I feel it's selfish to be tired when he's the one who's ill.

facts.heading: Does not tell sister how he feels
facts.content: Daniel tells his sister Hannah that he is fine when she asks.
facts.evidence: She asks how I am and I say fine.

facts.heading: Cannot face hospital visits
facts.content: Daniel sometimes sits in the hospital car park for ten minutes before going in.
facts.evidence: some days I sit in the car park at the hospital for ten minutes before I go in

facts.heading: GP blood tests normal
facts.content: Daniel's GP ran blood tests, and they were all normal.
facts.evidence: She did blood tests, and they were all normal.

facts.heading: GP suggests talking to someone
facts.content: Daniel's GP suggested he talk to someone about his stress and exhaustion.
facts.evidence: asked if I'd thought about talking to someone.

facts.heading: Girlfriend booked appointment
facts.content: Claire booked the appointment for Daniel.
facts.evidence: My girlfriend booked it, to be honest. Claire.

facts.heading: Claire concerned about Daniel
facts.content: Claire is concerned because she feels she is 'done watching him disappear'.
facts.evidence: She said she was done watching me disappear.

facts.heading: Claire is patient with Daniel
facts.content: Claire is patient with Daniel and makes him tea without pushing him to talk.
facts.evidence: She makes me tea and doesn't push me to talk.

facts.heading: Claire's patience wearing thin
facts.content: Daniel can see that Claire's patience is wearing on her.
facts.evidence: But I can see it's wearing on her too.

facts.heading: Stopped going away with Claire
facts.content: Claire stopped asking Daniel to go away for the weekend.
facts.evidence: She stopped asking if I want to go away for the weekend

facts.heading: Daniel avoids trips due to work
facts.content: Daniel avoids weekend trips because he anticipates receiving two hundred emails and his Dad might need something.
facts.evidence: The emails. If I'm away I'll come back to two hundred of them. And Dad might need something.

facts.heading: Stopped running two months ago
facts.content: Daniel stopped running about two months ago.
facts.evidence: I stopped about two months ago.

facts.heading: Ran ten kilometres for six years
facts.content: Daniel used to run ten kilometres every Saturday morning for six years.
facts.evidence: I ran. Ten kilometres every Saturday morning. I'd done it for six years.

facts.heading: Boss sends late emails
facts.content: Daniel's boss, Peterson, sends emails at eleven at night and expects answers before breakfast.
facts.evidence: he sends emails at eleven at night and expects an answer before breakfast.

facts.heading: Daniel answers boss's late emails
facts.content: Daniel answers every email from his boss, even if he is in bed.
facts.evidence: I answer it. Every time. Even if I'm in bed.

facts.heading: Fear of being seen as uncommitted
facts.content: Daniel fears his boss will think he is not committed if he doesn't answer the emails.
facts.evidence: That he'd think I wasn't committed.

facts.heading: Fear of job loss in spring
facts.content: Daniel is afraid that he might be let go due to a restructuring in the spring.
facts.evidence: There's a restructuring in the spring and I'm afraid they'll let me go.

facts.heading: Mortgage is a financial concern
facts.content: Daniel has a mortgage.
facts.evidence: I have a mortgage.

facts.heading: Moods are flat and irritable
facts.content: Daniel reports feeling flat and irritable, apart from the tiredness.
facts.evidence: Flat, mostly. And irritable.

facts.heading: Snapped at colleague last week
facts.content: Daniel snapped at a colleague last week over nothing.
facts.evidence: I snapped at a colleague last week over nothing

facts.heading: Experienced physical symptoms in toilet
facts.content: Daniel experienced his heart racing and hands shaking while in the toilets.
facts.evidence: My heart was going and my hands were shaking.

facts.heading: Past panic attack on train
facts.content: Daniel experienced a panic attack on the train to Manchester.
facts.evidence: Once on the train to Manchester. I just had to get off and stand on the platform.

facts.heading: Has not told Claire about episode
facts.content: Daniel has not told Claire about the episode.
facts.evidence: I haven't told anyone about it, not even Claire.

facts.heading: Fears losing control
facts.content: Daniel fears he is losing control and not coping.
facts.evidence: That I'm losing it. That I'm going to end up like, I don't know. Not coping.

facts.heading: Coffee intake is six cups daily
facts.content: Daniel drinks about six cups of coffee per day.
facts.evidence: Coffee, probably. I'm on about six cups a day.

facts.heading: Uses wine in evenings to switch off
facts.content: Daniel has started drinking wine in the evenings to switch his head off.
facts.evidence: And I've started having wine in the evenings to switch my head off.

facts.heading: Drinks two to three glasses of wine
facts.content: Daniel drinks two or sometimes three glasses of wine in the evenings.
facts.evidence: Two glasses, sometimes three.

facts.heading: Feels uneasy about wine use
facts.content: Daniel feels uneasy about his use of wine.
facts.evidence: Uneasy.

facts.heading: Wakes up at three AM after wine
facts.content: Daniel wakes up at three in the morning even after drinking wine.
facts.evidence: It works for an hour and then I wake at three anyway.

facts.heading: Feels relief from talking
facts.content: Daniel felt a sense of relief after sharing his burdens.
facts.evidence: A bit of a relief, actually. Like putting down a bag I didn't realise I was carrying.

facts.heading: Wants to address sleep issues first
facts.content: Daniel feels that if he could sleep, he could cope with the rest.
facts.evidence: The nights, I think. If I could sleep I could probably cope with the rest.

facts.heading: Grandfather worked in Yorkshire mines
facts.content: Daniel's grandfather worked in the mines in Yorkshire.
facts.evidence: My grandfather worked in the mines in Yorkshire.

facts.heading: Family pattern of not complaining
facts.content: Daniel states that his grandfather and father never complained about anything.
facts.evidence: He never complained about anything, not once. Dad's the same.

facts.heading: Feels pressure from family expectations
facts.content: Daniel worries his grandfather would think he was weak for being there.
facts.evidence: I keep thinking he would think I was weak for being here.

facts.heading: Wants to tell grandfather he is not weak
facts.content: Daniel wishes he could tell his grandfather that he is not weak.
facts.evidence: That I'm not weak.

facts.heading: Agrees to try phone break
facts.content: Daniel agreed to try a small change regarding his phone use.
facts.evidence: Yes.

facts.heading: Plans phone break with Claire
facts.content: Daniel plans to try the phone break at half past nine with Claire having tea on the sofa.
facts.evidence: Half past nine, perhaps. I could make it a thing with Claire. Tea on the sofa.

facts.heading: Will track sleep quality
facts.content: Daniel will write down how the night goes when he wakes up.
facts.evidence: I'll write down when I wake up, if I wake up.

facts.heading: Feels tired but lighter now
facts.content: Daniel feels tired but lighter after the session.
facts.evidence: Tired, but lighter.

facts.heading: Plans for next session
facts.content: Daniel plans to attend the next session next week.
facts.evidence: Same time next week?

facts.heading: Travel difficulty to sessions
facts.content: Daniel finds the trains difficult to use for travel.
facts.evidence: the trains are awful
